text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated CPU on tokenizer pods in prod (us-west-2). Autoscaler reports sustained 95% CPU across tokenizer-*/replica set. Multiple pod OOMs observed. Paging on-call.

bob_runtime: seeing a tight loop in tokenization when very long single-line prompts hit the `bytepair` stage. CPU climbs, threads spin. stack samples attached below.

bob_runtime: logs snippet:```
E0921 12:34:11.123 tokenizer.cpp:452] processed_prompt len=1,024,000 -> backtrack loop
CPU 98% user 1% sys
signal: oom-killer? container killed with exit code 137
```

jay_sre: confirmed node-level OOMs on node ip-10-0-5-12. kubelet evicted pods, docker/containerd restarted those containers. Filesystem pressure? not seeing it, looks pure CPU + oom_kill.

lina_support: support triage: two customers reported degraded responses and 502s starting ~12:33. Accounts: AcmeCorp (high volume), BrightHealth (batch ingest). Escalation thread opened. 

amy_oncall: I'm on it. I'm going to cordon node-12 and drain one affected node, then scale down tokenizer replicas to reduce churn and redeploy with limited concurrency.

jay_sre: suggested quick mitigations: 1) reduce concurrency env (TOKENIZER_MAX_WORKERS=2) 2) patch deployment resource requests to increase CPU request temporarily 3) cordon & drain offending node 4) restart pods gradually (canary) 5) add a short-term admission limit on request size.

bob_runtime: quick patch I can push to runtime image to guard against pathological prompt lengths: reject inputs > 200k tokens with 400 + error. I can build a short-lived image `run/guard:hotfix-205234` and ask deploy-bot to roll.

amy_oncall: doing steps now. commands:```bash
# cordon & drain
kubectl cordon ip-10-0-5-12
kubectl drain ip-10-0-5-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
# patch deployment env
kubectl set env deploy/tokenizer --env="TOKENIZER_MAX_WORKERS=2"
kubectl patch deployment/tokenizer -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"tokenizer","resources":{"requests":{"cpu":"800m","memory":"1Gi"}}}]}}}}'
# scale to 1 temporarily
kubectl scale deploy tokenizer --replicas=1
```

deploy-bot: deploy started for run/guard:hotfix-205234 -> deployment/tokenizer (canary 10%) by bob_runtime at 2052345760.

bob_runtime: can confirm guard returns immediately for >200k tokens:```json
{"error":"prompt too large: max 200000 tokens"}
```

lina_support: Customer impact: AcmeCorp had 12 failing jobs (ingest pipeline) — queued but retrying; BrightHealth batch jobs delayed ~3-5m and some 502s. No data loss reported. We've notified both customer CSMs and opened support tickets.

jay_sre: monitoring: node 10.0.5.12 cordoned, pods evacuated. CPU utilization cluster-wide down from 92% -> 45% over 3 minutes after scale/patch. Heap/stack dumps show tokenizer backtrack spikes reduced.

miguel_product: heads-up to prod and docs: we should add a durable guard in prompt pipeline to break up huge single-line inputs and rate-limit by token-length per request.

amy_oncall: handoff note: patch + limited concurrency applied, node drained, canary deployed. Will keep an eye for 30m. If stable, I'll roll to 100% and restore replicas. Taking ownership until 13:10 UTC.

bob_runtime: I'm going to follow up with a proper fix (split long inputs earlier, incremental tokenization) and an E2E test to prevent regressions. I'll attach a PR draft.

lina_support: posting customer notifications: AcmeCorp status: degraded -> retrying; BrightHealth: degraded but recovering. ETA for full restore 30-45m.

amy_oncall: tagging @jay_sre for postmortem. Please collect kernel OOM logs and coredumps; I'll collect kube events + pod restart timelines.

jay_sre: will collect logs and start an incident page. severity=P1 -> priority postmortem.

amy_oncall: handing off to night oncall at 2052345999. Actions outstanding: roll canary to 100% if no regressions, finalize customer notes, confirm PR for tokenizer-split.

incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated (partial), assigned=amy_oncall, severity=P1, incident_id=INC-205234. For full RCA, create postmortem in /incidents/postmortems and tag `tokenizer-hotloop`.
